scope: Make DRW_Surface DWG encoding transactional across common body, raw body bits, subtype fields and deferred handle output; prove allocation-failure rollback and same-object retry for a bounded plane-surface profile.

changes: Run common entity encoding, raw or typed surface body emission, entity handles, lofted-surface deferred handles and caller stream publication through encodeEntityDwgTransaction.
Preserve existing subtype/runtime checks, version gates, field ordering, and handle roles.
implementation.failureBehavior: Injected allocation failure preserves caller stream bytes and bit positions and restores the writer object type; retrying the same object with the same buffers reproduces clean output.

validation.allocationSweep: PASS: 4,091 allocation offsets across HATCH, MPOLYGON, MLEADER, ARCALIGNEDTEXT, LIGHT, SECTIONOBJECT, GEOPOSITIONMARKER, CAMERA, and PLANESURFACE; 205 entity/version/stream-layout profiles

coverage: Generated AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032 plane-surface profiles use five body/string/handle alias layouts each.
The typed plane profile emits a bounded empty modeler body and non-default U/V isoline counts.
Each injected allocation failure checks stream rollback and object-type restoration, then retries the same object into the same seeded buffers and compares exact output with clean encoding.
limitations: The allocation sweep exercises only the generated plane subtype; the Extruded, Revolved, Swept, Lofted and NURBS branches still need direct transaction profiles, including deferred lofted handles and version-bound raw bodies.
This does not qualify surface wire semantics, ACIS geometry, source graph closure, native rendering, or output support.
No DWG or DXF drawing fixture was added.
